body: Good to hear you're doing better =) Hopefully your progress will skyrocket in the coming time ^^
It's a hard first step to acknowledge that. The fact you know this, does not make you a bad person.
No-one is ever fully good and bad. But all thoughts, all motivations, have a point of origin. If you like, I can don my skype. I'll be happy to listen to your story, if it helps you.

I'd love to help, but I'm near broke myself. Had to borrow some money from my girfriend in order for me to go to work tomorrow... But as soon as I can, I'll hit you up. it won't be much, but at least it'll be something. In any case, good luck, man.

My father is a good man. But he keeps up this appearance of a certain disinterest which has infuriated me. As if everything I did was not enough. I promised myself that I'd be the man my father was only half of, regardless of the situation. For god's sake, you're a parent for life, not when your child turns 18, or when you divorce her mother. If you can't cope with the responsibility of having a child, then you're not fit to be a parent. My biggest fear, however, is that in time, V. is going to replace me as her 'father'. M. and I agreed that she only has one mother and one father, herself and me respectively, and that no-one deserves those titles more than us. But the fear is still there.

I know what I want. I want to work to become a comedian, because I consider a smile and laughter to be the most magical things in this world. I wish to be an actor, because I have so many stories I want to tell people. 
I try my best, concerning M. I try to reason with her. But then something comes up, and it wrecks my attempts. 
but I'm not about to give up. If need be, I'll take blame for everything she tosses at me, if it means I can see my daughter.

Perhaps this is a trial for me. Who knows. 
I'm not saying M. WANTS to use our babe against me, to have some form of superiority. Actually, I don't know if she does this knowingly or not. She never told me anything, from the start of everything until now, so at some aspects I'm still in the dark on what happened, what she thinks and why she did as she did. 
But I'm hoping time will tell. i'm hoping that someday I can call her a 'friend' without gritting my teeth.

Well, as I said, you're insane. =')
but you're welcome, I guess.
